responsibility: This file implements the runtime pass-management core for GCC. It defines default opt_pass behavior, tracks current_pass for diagnostics and plugins, executes local, IPA, and nested pass lists through pass_manager, handles pass dump-file and timevar bookkeeping, runs IPA summary readers and stmt-fixup hooks, and contains key top-level compiler hooks such as rest_of_decl_compilation and helpers for querying pass properties or whether processed nodes call the current function. Its responsibility is orchestration and execution semantics of the pass pipeline, complementing the declarative pipeline order in passes.def.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/passes.def, which declaratively lists the pass pipeline order and nesting, this file implements the runtime machinery that owns pass objects, tracks current_pass, executes pass lists and IPA hooks, and manages dump/timevar bookkeeping while the pipeline runs.
